_comment: Template — copy to config.json and fill in ONLY the providers you use. Leave every unused key as an empty string: the runtime treats any nonempty value as a configured credential and it would override CLI-login credential discovery. Secrets saved via the dashboard are encrypted at rest automatically. Optional per-provider overrides go under "providers", e.g. {"zai": {"max_concurrent": 6, "queue_timeout_ms": 60000}} — max_concurrent caps simultaneous requests (0 = unlimited, default 6 for zai to match z.ai plan limits) and queue_timeout_ms bounds the wait for a free slot (0 = wait forever).
